title: Synthetic example: a pure London week label for activity lines

model.name: example-codex-model
model.why: Synthetic. A real card names the model and effort the reference architecture measured, re-checked against Codex's own model list at dispatch.

interface:
export function weekLabel(mondayIso: string): string
- mondayIso is a London Monday as YYYY-MM-DD; anything else throws RangeError('not a Monday').
- Returns 'the week of <D> <Month> <YYYY>', for example weekLabel('2026-11-09') === 'the week of 9 November 2026'.
- Pure: no clock, no file, no network. No em dash or en dash in any string.
